lead_independence.headline: Martin County animal hoarding case grows to 108 rescued dogs and cats
lead_independence.lead: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast says animals continue to come in from the same case. Sarah Fisher of the Humane Society of the Treasure Coast said every single day more animals are coming forth from the same case. Fisher said the shelter needs community support to keep up with the growing number of animals in its care.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Boca Raton to invest over $1 million in police staffing to address homelessness

lead_independence.headline: Boca Raton to invest over $1 million in police staffing to address homelessness
lead_independence.lead: During a Monday workshop, city leaders directed City Manager Mark Sohaney to move forward with hiring four new police officers, a Community Resource Coordinator, and creating a Quality-of-Life Working Group. Mayor Andy Thomson said the investment is designed to strengthen both public safety and services for people experiencing homelessness. Thomson said the city recognizes that homelessness is a growing issue in Boca Raton.
